questions.question: Born on this day in 1948, which musician was a founding member, co-lead singer, and frontman of the rock band Eagles?
questions.explanation: Glenn Frey co-founded the Eagles and shared lead vocal duties while co-writing much of the group's music.
questions.context:
On this day in 1948: Glenn Frey, American singer-songwriter, guitarist, and actor (died 2016)
Glenn Frey (American rock musician and songwriter (1948–2016)): Glenn Lewis Frey was an American musician and songwriter. He was a founding member of the rock band Eagles, for whom he was the co-lead singer and frontman, roles he came to share with fellow member Don Henley, with whom he wrote most of Eagles' material.

questions.question: Which two political parties have dominated American national politics since the 1850s?
questions.explanation: The Republican Party was founded in 1854, and together with the Democratic Party, it has shaped the American political landscape ever since.
questions.context: Republican Party (United States) (Political party): The Republican Party, also known as the Grand Old Party (GOP), is a right-wing populist and neo-nationalist political party in the United States, sitting on the right-wing to far-right of the political spectrum. Founded in 1854, it emerged as the main rival of the Democratic Party in the 1850s, and the two parties have dominated American politics since then.

questions.question: Which internet top-level domain, created by Daniel Negari, was made available to the general public in June 2014?
questions.explanation: The domain name .xyz was introduced under ICANN's generic top-level domain program and launched publicly on 2 June 2014.
questions.context: .xyz (Internet top-level domain): .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program. Its name consists of the last three letters of the Latin-script alphabet. XYZ.com and CentralNic are the registries for the domain, which was created by entrepreneur Daniel Negari. It became available to the general public on June 2, 2014, thereafter becoming widely used by tech startups, creators, and Web3 projects.

questions.question: Which political party, established in 1828, is recognised as the world's oldest active political party?
questions.explanation: Founded in 1828, the United States Democratic Party holds the title of the world's oldest political party still in operation.
questions.context: Democratic Party (United States) (Political party): The Democratic Party is a liberal political party in the United States, sitting on the center to center-left of the political spectrum. Founded in 1828, it is the world's oldest active political party. Its main rival is the Republican Party, and since the 1850s, both have dominated American politics.

questions.question: Which American politician was elected in 2021 as the youngest incumbent member of the United States Senate?
questions.explanation: Jon Ossoff assumed office as a U.S. senator from Georgia in 2021, holding the distinction of being the youngest serving senator.
questions.context: Jon Ossoff (American politician (born 1987)): Thomas Jonathan Ossoff is an American politician who has served as the senior United States senator from Georgia since 2021. He is the youngest incumbent U.S. senator, and a member of the Democratic Party.
